Лабораторная работа 3: Перенос знаний с использованием PyTorch¶

Задачи работы:¶

  • Загрузить набор данных Garbage Classification и выполнить предобработку данных, если это необходимо.
  • Выбрать 4 архитектуры нейронных сетей, для которых в открытом доступе существуют веса, настроенные на наборе данных ImageNet.
  • Модифицировать выбранные архитектуры нейронных сетей для работы с набором данных Garbage Classification. Выбрать гиперпараметры обучения и функцию ошибки. Обучить модели со случайными весами на наборе данных Garbage Classification.
  • Обучить модель с весами, предварительно обученными на наборе данных ImageNet, на том же наборе данных Garbage Classification.
  • Сравнить результаты обученных моделей по метрикам точности.

def createDatasets(path, resolution, seed = 42):
    full_dataset = ImageFolder(
        root=path,
        transform=transforms.Compose([
            transforms.Resize(resolution),
            transforms.ToTensor(),
        ])
    )

    # data split
    total_size = len(full_dataset)
    train_size = int(0.7 * total_size)
    val_size = int(0.15 * total_size)
    test_size = total_size - train_size - val_size

    train_dataset, val_dataset, test_dataset = random_split(
        full_dataset,
        [train_size, val_size, test_size],
        generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    )

    return train_dataset, val_dataset, test_dataset, full_dataset.classes

Вспомогательные функции:

In [9]:
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
def macro_f1_score(y_true, y_pred):
  with torch.no_grad():
    return f1_score(y_true, y_pred, average='macro', zero_division=0)
In [10]:
def get_optimizer(model):
  optimizer = optim.Adam(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=LEARNING_RATE
    )
  return optimizer
In [11]:
def train_epoch(model, dataloader, criterion, optimizer, num_epochs):
  model.train()
  running_loss = 0.0
  all_preds = []
  all_labels = []

  for inputs, labels in train_loader:
    inputs, labels = inputs.to(device), labels.to(device)

    optimizer.zero_grad()
    outputs = model(inputs)
    loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()

    running_loss += loss.item()
    _, preds = torch.max(outputs, 1)

    all_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
    all_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())

  epoch_loss = running_loss / len(train_loader)
  epoch_f1 = macro_f1_score(all_labels, all_preds)

  return epoch_loss, epoch_f1
In [12]:
def validate_epoch(model, val_loader, criterion, device):
    model.eval()
    running_loss = 0.0
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []

    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, labels in train_loader:
            images, labels = images.to(device), labels.to(device)

            outputs = model(images)
            loss = criterion(outputs, labels)
            running_loss += loss.item()
            _, preds = torch.max(outputs, 1)

            all_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.extend(labels.cpu().numpy())

    epoch_loss = running_loss / len(val_loader)
    epoch_f1 = macro_f1_score(all_labels, all_preds)

    return epoch_loss, epoch_f1
In [13]:
def train_model(model, train_loader, val_loader, criterion, optimizer, epochs=EPOCHS):
  best_f1 = 0.0
  history = {
      'train_loss': [],
      'train_f1': [],
      'val_loss': [],
      'val_f1': []
  }
  for epoch in range(epochs):
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS}")

    train_loss, train_f1 = train_epoch(
        model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer, device
    )

    val_loss, val_f1 = validate_epoch(
        model, val_loader, criterion, device
    )

    history['train_loss'].append(train_loss)
    history['train_f1'].append(train_f1)
    history['val_loss'].append(val_loss)
    history['val_f1'].append(val_f1)

    print(f"Train - Loss: {train_loss:.4f}, F1: {train_f1:.4f}")
    print(f"Val   - Loss: {val_loss:.4f}, F1: {val_f1:.4f}")
    print()
  return model, history
In [14]:
def plot_training_history_basic(history, save_path=None):
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, figsize=(15, 10))

    epochs = range(1, len(history['train_loss']) + 1)

    axes[0].plot(epochs, history['train_loss'], 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Train Loss')
    axes[0].plot(epochs, history['val_loss'], 'r-', linewidth=2, label='Val Loss')
    axes[0].set_title('Loss', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[0].set_xlabel('Epochs')
    axes[0].set_ylabel('Loss')
    axes[0].legend()
    axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    axes[0].xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))

    axes[1].plot(epochs, history['train_f1'], 'b-', linewidth=2, label='Train F1')
    axes[1].plot(epochs, history['val_f1'], 'r-', linewidth=2, label='Val F1')
    axes[1].set_title('macro F1 Score', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
    axes[1].set_xlabel('Epochs')
    axes[1].set_ylabel('F1 Score')
    axes[1].legend()
    axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    axes[1].xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))

    plt.show()

    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("ФИНАЛЬНЫЕ РЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ:")
    print(f"Train Loss: {history['train_loss'][-1]:.4f}")
    print(f"Val Loss:   {history['val_loss'][-1]:.4f}")
    print(f"Train F1:   {history['train_f1'][-1]:.4f}")
    print(f"Val F1:     {history['val_f1'][-1]:.4f}")
    print("="*50)

from torchvision.models import ResNet50_Weights
def ResNet50_pretrained():
  model = resnet50(weights=ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V2)
  for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
  num_features = model.fc.in_features
  model.fc = torch.nn.Linear(num_features, NUM_CLASSES, bias=True)
  for param in model.fc.parameters():
      param.requires_grad = True
  return model

Предобученная модель¶

In [45]:
model = models.densenet121(weights='IMAGENET1K_V1')
In [46]:
def DenseNet121_pretrained():
  model = models.densenet121(weights='IMAGENET1K_V1')
  for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False
  num_ftrs = model.classifier.in_features
  model.classifier = nn.Linear(num_ftrs, NUM_CLASSES)

  for param in model.classifier.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = True
  return model
In [47]:
